A INVESTIGATION (QUESTIONS 1 TO 4)
CLOCK HANDS (30 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 50 minutes on this part.
This investigation looks at the angle between the hands of a clock at different times of day.
You should not measure angles from the clock diagrams.

In this investigation: \(\bullet\) the hour hand is labelled \(H\) \(\bullet\) the minute hand is labelled \(M\) \(\bullet\) the hands of the clock rotate clockwise in the direction shown \(\bullet\) the clockwise angle between the two hands is shown on the clock.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) The clock shows the time 1.00 am. In one hour, hand H rotates clockwise from one number to the next number. For example, from 1.00 am to 2.00 am hand H rotates from 1 to 2. Show that hand H rotates 0.5° in one minute. [2]
